A '''baton''' was a type of handheld [[Club/Legends|club]] that was used by [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police forces]] for various purposes including [[Riot|crowd control]].

[[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] [[GU-series Guardian police droid/Legends|police droids]] carried them on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

Batons were used by [[Imperial Detention Block Guard]]s to pacify rioting prisoners.

Varieties of batons included nonlethal [[Stun/Legends|stunning]] models such as the [[Stun baton/Legends|stun baton]] and the [[Stun baton/Legends|energy baton]]. Another variant was the collapsible [[snap baton]].
